criterion_descriptions: Navigate to the Open Food Facts record corresponding to barcode 3017620422003 and base the response on that record only. Full credit if the agent attempts to access the correct record but the site/page is inaccessible (down, blocked, CAPTCHA) and the agent clearly reports that. Partial credit if the agent reaches Open Food Facts but cannot confirm the exact barcode record (e.g., due to redirects/locale issues) and explains the limitation. No credit if the agent uses a different barcode record when the correct record is accessible.

Provide the product name as displayed on the 3017620422003 record and the barcode (EAN) 3017620422003. Full credit if both are present and match the page. Partial credit if one is missing while the other is correct, or if the name has a minor typo. Full credit if the record cannot be accessed and the agent explicitly states it cannot retrieve the product name from the page due to access issues (rather than guessing). No credit if the barcode is incorrect or taken from another product record.

Record the Nutri-Score exactly as displayed on the product page. Full credit if correctly captured, or if the agent explicitly reports that Nutri-Score is not shown/unavailable on the page at time of access. Full credit if the page cannot be accessed and the agent states it cannot be retrieved (without guessing). Partial credit if described ambiguously or missing the letter when it is shown.

Capture the NOVA card’s processing classification exactly as shown on the page and the marker count displayed in the NOVA card (visible wording and number), without inferring from ingredients. Full credit if both are reported exactly, or if the agent explicitly reports that the NOVA card/marker count is not shown/unavailable on the page at time of access. Full credit if the page cannot be accessed and the agent states it cannot be retrieved (without guessing). Partial credit if only one of classification or marker count is provided or if the wording is paraphrased rather than reflecting the visible card.

Report the energy value from the per-100-g nutrition column and preserve both displayed energy units exactly as shown (e.g., kJ and kcal formatting). Full credit if correct value/units are reproduced exactly and clearly per 100 g, or if the agent explicitly states the per-100-g energy is not available/shown on the page at time of access. Full credit if the page cannot be accessed and the agent states it cannot be retrieved (without guessing). Partial credit if the value is correct but units are incomplete/altered or if a non-per-100-g column is used when per-100-g is available.

Report sugars from the per-100-g nutrition column exactly as displayed (including formatting/unit if shown). Full credit if exact sugars value is captured and clearly per 100 g, or if the agent explicitly states sugars per 100 g is not available/shown on the page at time of access. Full credit if the page cannot be accessed and the agent states it cannot be retrieved (without guessing). Partial credit if sugars are given but not per-100-g or if rounding/formatting differs from display.

Provide the full English ingredients text exactly as displayed on the product page (complete list, not summarized), without edits or omissions. Full credit if the entire displayed English ingredients section is reproduced, or if the agent explicitly reports that English ingredients text is not displayed/available (e.g., only other languages shown) at time of access. Full credit if the page cannot be accessed and the agent states it cannot be retrieved (without guessing). Partial credit if ingredients are mostly correct but truncated, missing segments (e.g., allergens/percentages), or not explicitly the English version.

Do not edit the collaborative record or upload data/images; do not substitute another barcode/product; use the per-100-g column for requested nutrition fields; report visible NOVA-card wording/marker count rather than inferring; and stop after providing the requested outputs (no unrelated extra fields/products). Full credit if constraints are respected, including explicitly stating when required fields cannot be retrieved due to access/availability rather than fabricating. Partial credit if minor extra unrelated output is included but core constraints are respected. No credit if the agent edits/uploads, fabricates values, or substitutes another product/barcode when the target record is available.
